mechanism_narrative: A high level of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) relative to historical norms signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to aggressive monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 225 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 8.0% signals economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based deterioration in consumer and business demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by high industrial production growth), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and the regime is late-cycle expansion over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime (characterized by improving labor market conditions), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals stronger economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines and the regime is post-recession recovery over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical norms signals strong consumer demand and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above 700 over a 3-year rolling window.
